privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Pohnch shows a child's school van on the parent's phone. We keep as little as we can, and only the right people see it.
privacy.collect.title: What we keep
privacy.collect.body: Parents: mobile number, the name you choose, language. Children: first name only, school, and the home spot you place on the map yourself. Drivers: mobile number, name, van name, school, number plate and stops. During trips: the van's location and the driver's taps (when, and by whom). Your phone's notification token, to send alerts. Quick messages you send the driver ("2 minutes", "sick today"), one-run days off, and things the driver found in the van. Your get-ready and Friday alert choices stay on your phone.
privacy.never.title: What we never keep
privacy.never.body: A child's photo, phone number or gender. The parent's phone location (the parent app never asks for it). The van's location outside trips. We don't sell data and show no ads. To show rain, the apps ask Open-Meteo (a free weather service) for Karachi's weather at one fixed city-centre point; no location of yours or the van is sent.
privacy.who.title: Who sees what
privacy.who.body: Parents see only their own child, their own van, its location during trips, and their own stop; never other families' stops. Drivers see only the first names and stops of the children on their van. The Pohnch team can see it to help and to check drivers.
privacy.keep.title: How long
privacy.keep.body: The van's location is deleted automatically after 30 days. You can delete your account and your children's details yourself in the app (Menu, then Delete my account), or WhatsApp us and we'll delete them within 7 days.
privacy.safe.title: Keeping it safe
privacy.safe.body: Every table has access rules: each person can read only their own rows. Invite links are stored only in scrambled (hashed) form, never the link itself. Names, numbers and links are never written to logs.
privacy.contact.title: Contact
privacy.contact.body: Questions or complaints: WhatsApp 0300 1478729. If this policy changes, we'll tell you in the app.

site.hero.lead: Watch your child's school van on a map, minutes to your door. A calm alert when they get in, reach school, and come home.
site.p.verified.b: The Pohnch team checks every driver's ID and van before any family can join.
site.p.trip.b: The van shows from Start trip to End trip, never at other times. The parent app never asks for your location.
site.p.gone.b: Old van positions delete themselves after 30 days.
site.p.names.b: Just a child's first name, school and stop. No photo, no phone number, no gender.
site.p.seat.b: At the end of every trip the driver confirms the van is empty.
site.p.calm.b: Over 50 km/h the driver hears a reminder, and the Pohnch team sees it.
site.p.help.b: One tap calls 15 or 1122, and tells every family why the van is late.

site.terms.title: Terms of use
site.terms.1.b: Pohnch shows a school van's trip to the families who ride it. Pohnch does not drive or own vans; drivers run their own vans.
site.terms.2.b: During the pilot Pohnch is free. If that changes, we'll tell you in the app first, and you can stop at any time.
site.terms.3.b: Minutes and alerts depend on the driver's phone and signal. In an emergency, call 15 or 1122 first.
site.terms.4.b: Use your own mobile number, add only your own children, and keep invite links to yourself.
site.terms.5.b: Drivers tap only when the van is stopped, follow traffic law, and share location only during trips. We may switch off a van that breaks these rules.
site.terms.6.b: Questions: WhatsApp 0300 1478729. These terms follow the law of Pakistan.

journey.kit.card: Scan to see the free driver app
journey.share.text: Our school van, live on the map, with an alert at each step. Free in the pilot: https://pohnch.pk
journey.why.title: Why we built this
journey.why.body: Every morning in Karachi, parents stand at the gate with a phone to their ear, calling a driver who can’t answer. We wanted that call to stop. Pohnch starts small, with a few vans, and we listen to every family and every driver.
